card.title: IPad Pro 12.9in and 11in No Face ID After Removing The Screen Repair

source.title: IPad Pro 12.9in and 11in No Face ID After Removing The Screen Repair

symptoms: Face ID not available after opening

claims.statement: On Face ID iPad Pros, 'Face ID is not available' after opening is usually a damaged ambient light sensor on the top flex; the ALS sensors aren't part of Face ID but a damaged one breaks it.
The flood illuminator, dot projector and IR camera must be original; the whole top flex cannot be swapped.
Quick fix: cut the damaged ALS off the flex. Proper fix: desolder the ALS sub-flex (joints under a sticker mid-flex) and fit a new one; auto-brightness and True Tone keep working either way.

procedure: Inspect the ALS sensors on the top flex for lifting/damage.
Cut off the damaged ALS, or desolder and replace the ALS sub-flex.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
